title: Wobbles per turn of the seal, for a spinning object with a small tilt
description: Bar chart. For a symmetric object spinning freely with a small tilt, the tilt goes round I3/I1 times for each turn of a mark on its rim, where I3 is the moment of inertia about the symmetry axis and I1 about a diameter. Feynman's telling: 0.5. A thin disc: 2.00. A coin one-tenth as thick as its radius: 1.99. A hockey puck (25.4 mm thick, 76.2 mm across): 1.74. A cylinder as tall as its radius: 1.50. A cylinder whose height is 1.73 times its radius: 1.00. Computed for kloom from the moments of inertia of a uniform cylinder.
heading: WOBBLES PER TURN OF THE SEAL · SMALL TILT
